entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: H、R 两栏为[空]，M 首音节 T99 污損难辨，仅存 L『Corridor batauas』，四栏材料不足，无从定夺。

entries.zh: 规正，按规矩匡正；规（规矩、准则）
entries.en: to correct, to rectify; a rule, standard

entries.zh: 该（应当）；该当受罚、合当惩戒
entries.en: ought, should; deserving of correction or punishment

entries.zh: 押：押住、按压；压制约束
entries.en: to press down, to restrain; to detain
entries.notes: M/R 音读存疑（àt/à、yā/zā），据 H 押 与 corregir 之惩戒义取压束、压制。

entries.zh: 断：断罪、决断；断绝、了断
entries.en: to decide, to judge (a case); to cut off, to settle
entries.notes: M 首音存疑（toân/hoân），以 R toān 与 H 断 定读。

entries.zh: 督：监督、督责（居上位者督察纠正）
entries.en: to oversee, supervise; to correct as (or upon) a superior
entries.notes: M 音形存疑（Fôg/Pôg），据 H 督 与 R tō 定为督；L『cōs superior』为缩写，按 superior（上位者/上事）展开系推断。

entries.zh: 刑（刑罚、惩戒）；与西语『改正书册文字』之义不合，释义存疑
entries.en: to punish, to chastise; at odds with the Spanish lemma 'to correct things, books' — uncertain
entries.notes: H 刑 与 L『corregir cōs libros &』义不谐，M『Lán hiâg』、R『săn/sīn』均存疑，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 警：警戒；以儆戒方式纠正
entries.en: to warn, to admonish; to correct as a warning

entries.zh: 儆戒：警戒、告诫，使人知所鉴戒
entries.en: to admonish, to warn; an admonition

entries.zh: 押煞：按压制服、彻底压服
entries.en: to press down and subdue utterly; to crush
entries.notes: M『â Zôa』、R『īn iā（疑）』与 H 押煞 二字对音不合，字形或音读存疑，姑按押（压）加煞释义。

entries.zh: 压杀：以力压死、压毙
entries.en: to crush to death, to kill by pressure
entries.notes: L 词头存疑（agrimir/abrimir）；H 壓殺、M ap-sat、R iā-sā 三栏互证清晰。

entries.zh: 教张：疑为管教、调教之义；音读污损，释义存疑
entries.en: to discipline, to train (uncertain; partly illegible)
entries.notes: M 第二音节 T99 污損且 gìo/hio 存疑，『教張』确义无法定夺，仅 H 教張 与 R chiàng（張）可参。

entries.zh: 惩戒：惩处以示警戒
entries.en: to chastise, to punish as a warning; discipline

entries.zh: 面拆（面斥）：当面斥责、当面数落
entries.en: to rebuke to one's face; to correct with the tongue
entries.notes: L『al/ael』与 M『biēn/gien』存疑；据 H 面拆 与 R miēn chē 判为当面斥责之义。

entries.zh: 箴规：箴规、劝诫（以劝告方式纠正）
entries.en: to admonish and counsel; to correct by advice

entries.zh: 格言：格言、警句；『格』兼格正之义，以理纠正之言
entries.en: a maxim, aphorism; to rectify by reason
entries.notes: L『racon/razon』及 M/R 音读有疑；据 H/M/R 定为格言（kek-giân），『格』取格正义与西语相配。

entries.zh: 警省：警省、警醒（以警告促人省悟）
entries.en: to warn into self-reflection; to alert, to awaken

entries.zh: 行家法：依家规责罚家人子弟
entries.en: to enforce family discipline; to punish a family member by house rules

entries.zh: 跟：跟随；第二字存疑（究/宪），疑指跟踪查究
entries.en: to follow, to trail; possibly 'to track down, investigate' (second character uncertain)
entries.notes: H 第二字存疑（究/宪），M/R 同读 guīn guīn 仅证『跟』之跟随义，与 corregir 之关联未明。

entries.zh: 刑削（疑为『删削／改削』之误）：删改文字
entries.en: to excise or revise text; recorded compound at odds with the lemma 'to correct the writing'
entries.notes: H『刑削』与 L『corregir la escritura』义不谐，M（Lân/Lam）、R（săn/sīn）均存疑，姑按删削文字释义。

entries.zh: 诲戒：教诲劝戒
entries.en: to instruct and admonish; to correct by teaching and warning

entries.zh: 雕琢：雕琢（喻以教导琢磨陶冶）
entries.en: to carve and polish; figuratively, to mold by teaching
entries.notes: M 第二音节声调 T99 污損、tiâu/tiāu 存疑；字义据 H 彫琢 与『corregir enseñando』互证，按规程降为低置信。
